title: 第三章 日本帝国主义的运作机制
originalTitle: Chapter Three · Agency of Japanese Imperialism

zh: 间岛即今天的延边朝鲜族自治州，由吉林省与朝鲜北部接壤的四个县组成，是日本渗透扩张的原型。日本的大规模渗透使间岛成为二十世纪上半叶满洲殖民政治与民族政治中争议最激烈的场所。与满洲其他地区一样，现代主体与民族主权的形成同私有财产权的发展交织在一起，由此引发了间岛日本与中国民族力量之间的争端。然而，间岛独特的民族政治与殖民政治模式依托于当地的历史偶然性，例如中朝领土争端的历史遗留问题，以及朝鲜人在当地占多数的格局。这里的主要政治角色包括日本、间岛的中国行政当局（以下简称间岛政府），以及以朝鲜人国籍与土地所有权为媒介形成对抗关系的各朝鲜人政治团体。
en: Now known as the Yanbian Korean Autonomous Prefecture, with four counties of Jilin Province adjacent to northern Korea, Kando was the archetype of Japan’s osmotic expansion. Extensive penetration by Japan marked Kando as perhaps the most contentious site of colonial and national politics in Manchuria in the first half of the twentieth century. As in other parts of Manchuria, the formation of modern subjects and national sovereignty was intertwined with the development of private property ownership. This resulted in disputes between Japan and Chinese national forces in Kando. Yet distinctive patterns of national and colonial politics drew on historical contingencies in Kando, such as the legacy of territorial disputes between Korea and China and Koreans as its majority population. Here the key political players included Japan, the Chinese administration in Kando (hereafter the Kando Administration), and Korean political groups that developed confrontational relationships through the medium of Korean nationality and landownership.

zh: 日本在间岛的渗透扩张因对《间岛协约》与1915年条约的选择性适用而加速。前者保障了朝鲜人的居住权与土地所有权，后者保障了他们的治外法权。两项条约在间岛与朝鲜人之间制造出一种悖论性关系。一方面，日本领事馆与东洋拓殖株式会社——间岛主要的殖民开发公司——利用朝鲜人的权利，通过贷款巩固朝鲜人与日本之间的经济纽带。另一方面，朝鲜人的权利又为其战斗性的抗日运动奠定了基础。抗日活动意味着渗透的“渗漏”，即渗透过程中传输的中断。但日本把这一断裂时刻变成了扩大渗透扩张的机会。以镇压朝鲜人抵抗运动为名，日本领事馆与朝鲜总督府扩充保安力量，对朝鲜人行使主权。到1920年代中期，朝鲜人人口激增至约30万，占间岛人口的三分之二，日本以其对朝鲜人主张的权力为依据，进一步声称对间岛拥有主权。
en: Japan’s osmotic expansion in Kando accelerated with the selective adoption of the Kando and 1915 Treaties. The former ensured Koreans the rights of residence and landownership, and the latter ensured their extraterritoriality. The two treaties produced a paradoxical relationship between Kando and Koreans. On the one hand, Japanese consulates and the Oriental Development Company, the primary colonial development company in Kando, capitalized on Koreans’ rights so as to consolidate economic bonds between Koreans and Japan by means of loans. On the other hand, the rights of Koreans laid the foundation for their militant anti-Japanese movements. Anti-Japanese activities signified osmotic “leakage” or the interruption of osmotic transfusion. But Japan turned this moment of breakdown into an opportunity for increasing osmotic expansion. In the name of pacifying Korean resistance, Japanese consulates and the Government General of Korea expanded their security forces and wielded sovereignty over Koreans. When the Korean population swelled in the mid-1920s to about 300,000, or two-thirds of Kando’s population, Japan’s claims on Koreans conjured its sovereignty over Kando.

zh: 在领土与资本主义诉求的驱动下，中国在间岛的反殖民政治以双层同化政策推进：一是为朝鲜人入籍提供便利，二是准许未入籍的朝鲜人垦种荒地与水田。间岛朝鲜人入籍的主要诱因，是那些在其他地方只给予中国移民的社会计划，例如豁免地税、免费垦荒。间岛的同化政策还包括废止朝鲜人学校、强制采用中国语言与风俗。然而，国籍政策收效有限。间岛朝鲜人10%至15%的入籍率，与其他地区排斥性民族政策下的入籍率几乎相当。当间岛政府管制未入籍朝鲜人的土地所有权时，他们便以入籍朝鲜人的名义购地。尽管国籍政策屡遭挫败，间岛政府并未封锁与朝鲜的边界，而是引导未入籍朝鲜人去垦种荒地与水田。
en: Driven by territorial and capitalist quests, Chinese counter-colonial politics in Kando progressed with a two-tiered policy of assimilation: the facilitation of naturalization of Koreans and the validation of nonnaturalized Koreans for farming wasteland and rice fields. The principal incentives for Korean naturalization in Kando were social programs available elsewhere only to Chinese migrants, such as exemption from the land tax and cultivation of wasteland free of charge. The assimilation policies in Kando included abolition of Korean schools and obligatory adoption of the Chinese language and customs. However, the nationality policy had limited results. The 10 to 15 percent rate of naturalization among Koreans in Kando was almost equal to the rate under exclusionary national policies elsewhere. When the Kando Administration regulated landownership by nonnaturalized Koreans, they purchased land under the names of naturalized Koreans. Despite the continual failures of its nationality policies, the Kando Administration did not seal its border with Korea but instead directed nonnaturalized Koreans to farm wasteland and rice fields.

zh: 朝鲜人的政治并非完全由其对日本或中国的民族认同所决定，也在资本主义政治的领域展开。尽管间岛成为流亡朝鲜独立运动的中心，朝鲜人民会（一个主要的亲日组织）与各种自治组织仍持续关注满洲的社会状况问题。日本领事馆对间岛朝鲜人民会的监督，比对满洲其他地区的更为严密。间岛的朝鲜人民会倾向于吸纳小土地所有者与贫困农民，后者依靠贷款获取土地、农具或维持生计。相比之下，支持中国当局及其推动朝鲜人入籍政策的各类朝鲜人自治组织，则由土地精英领导。不同社会群体的参与加剧了朝鲜人政治的两极分化。然而，分裂的政治仍包含资本主义政治，因为追求私有财产权，是这些团体分别同日本或中国合作、并彼此竞争的共同出发点。
en: Korean politics was not dictated completely by their national identification with Japan and China but also encroached on capitalist politics. Although Kando became a center of the exiled Korean independence movement, the Korean Association (a primary pro-Japanese organization) and various self-rule organizations continued to address concerns about social conditions in Manchuria. Japanese consulates exercised closer supervision of the Korean Association in Kando than in other parts of Manchuria. The Korean Association in Kando tended to encompass small landowners and destitute peasants, who relied on loans for acquiring land, farm equipment, or subsistence. In contrast, various Korean self-rule organizations, which supported the Chinese authorities and their policy of promoting Korean naturalization, were led by landowning elites. Participation of disparate social groups accentuated the polarization of Korean politics. However, the divided politics encompassed capitalist politics, as the desire for private property ownership foregrounded any competing partnership with Japan or China.

zh: 本章首先讨论《间岛协约》与1915年条约，它们为日本提供了渗透扩张的两件工具——朝鲜人的土地所有权与治外法权。随后探讨间岛日本、中国与朝鲜人之间对抗性的三角政治，它为日本的渗透扩张奠定了政治与经济基础。本章还将考察中国民族的特殊形成过程与朝鲜人自治运动，中国人和朝鲜人正是经由它们设想从日本手中夺回领土与资本主义主权。
en: In this chapter, I first discuss the Kando Treaty and the 1915 Treaty, which supplied Japan with two instruments of osmotic expansion—Korean landownership and extraterritoriality. I then explore the confrontational triangular politics of Japan, China, and Koreans in Kando, which laid the political and economic foundations for Japan’s osmotic expansion. I also examine the specific formation of the Chinese nation and the Korean self-rule movement through which Chinese and Koreans envisaged regaining territorial and capitalist sovereignty from Japan.

zh: 《间岛协约》（1909年条约）与1915年条约
en: the kando treaty (1909 treaty) and the 1915 treaty

zh: 《间岛协约》塑造了间岛独特的民族政治与殖民政治。1905年与朝鲜签订《保护条约》后，日本重新挑起中朝之间由来已久的间岛领土争端。日本试图修改中朝两国一年前达成的一项决议，该决议允许朝鲜人在间岛居住、拥有土地，并向间岛政府纳税。这项决议既未申明朝鲜或中国的主权权利，也未澄清朝鲜人的国籍，而是把该地区命名为间岛（字面意思是“中国与朝鲜之间的中间地带”），暗示双方都不对其提出领有主张。
经过多年的争执，日本于1909年签订了《图们江中韩界务条款》，即《间岛协约》，承认间岛为中国领土。作为交换，中国允许设立日本领事馆，并允许日本臣民参与商业经营。
en: The Kando Treaty shaped distinctive national and colonial politics in Kando. After signing the Protectorate Treaty with Korea in 1905, Japan reopened age-old territorial disputes between China and Korea over Kando. Japan attempted to modify a resolution reached by China and Korea one year earlier, which allowed Koreans to reside in Kando, own land there, and pay taxes to the Kando Administration. This resolution neither stated the sovereign rights of Korea or China nor clarified the nationality of Koreans. Instead the resolution named the region Kando (literally the “middle land between China and Korea”), implying that it would not be claimed by either party.

After years of disagreement, in 1909 Japan signed the Tuman River China-Korean Boundary Treaty, also known as the Kando Treaty, which recognized Kando as Chinese territory. In return, China permitted the creation of Japanese consulates and the involvement of Japanese subjects in business.

zh: 《间岛协约》给朝鲜人带来的一个重大变化，是中国对他们主权的强化。与从前一样，朝鲜人无需入籍为中国国民即可继续在当地居住并拥有土地。协约第3款允许“朝鲜人居住于图们江以北的农地”。然而，依据中国对间岛的领土权利，朝鲜人处于中国的行政与司法管辖之下，朝鲜人的治外法权由此被排除。特别是第4款规定：“居住于杂居地域[朝鲜语chapkŏ chiyŏk，汉语zayu diyu——1880年以前允许朝鲜人开垦的区域]农地上的朝鲜人，须服从中国法律、缴纳税款，并接受中国官宪的裁判。”第5款则规定中国官员有责任保护朝鲜人拥有的土地与房屋。
en: A significant change for Koreans brought about by the Kando Treaty was the strengthening of Chinese sovereignty over them. As before, Koreans continued to reside and own land there without becoming naturalized as Chinese nationals. Article 3 of the treaty permitted “the residence of Koreans on agricultural lands lying north of the Tuman River.” Yet, in accordance with China’s territorial rights over Kando, Koreans were under Chinese administrative and judicial authority. Extraterritoriality for Koreans was thereby ruled out. In particular, Article 4 stated that “Koreans residing on agricultural lands in the mixed region [chapkŏ chiyŏk in Korean, zayu diyu in Chinese —the areas where Korean reclamation was allowed prior to 1880] shall submit to Chinese laws, pay taxes, and be adjudicated by Chinese authorities.” Article 5 held Chinese officials responsible for protecting land and houses owned by Koreans.

zh: 尽管《间岛协约》宣告间岛为中国领土，但这远非领土主权问题的解决。
en: Although the Kando Treaty proclaimed Kando to be Chinese territory, this was anything but a resolution of the problem of territorial sovereignty.

zh: 关于中国对朝鲜人行政与司法管辖权的规定过于薄弱，不足以保证中国的主权。尽管日本一年前已宣称朝鲜人是其臣民，协约却未明确其国籍。协约签订之后，日本的渗透政治把围绕对朝鲜人行使主权的争端，激化为围绕该地区主权的争端。由于朝鲜人占间岛人口的多数，日本的渗透政治对间岛中国主权的威胁，比对其他地区的更大。
en: The statement about Chinese administrative and judicial authority over Koreans was too weak to guarantee China’s sovereignty. Although Japan had asserted that Koreans were its subjects one year earlier, the treaty did not specify their nationality. In the aftermath of the treaty, Japan’s osmotic politics galvanized the dispute on sovereignty over Koreans into a dispute on sovereignty over the area. As Koreans constituted the majority of the population in Kando, Japan’s osmotic politics posed a greater threat to Chinese sovereignty in Kando than elsewhere.

zh: 尽管存在这种含混，中国为防止日本主张日本臣民的治外法权，仍不得不退而维护《间岛协约》。1915年条约本只涉及南满与蒙古，日本却坚持将其扩展适用于常被称为东满的间岛。如此一来，1915年条约将赋予朝鲜人治外法权，而这正是《间岛协约》所排除的。在1915年条约是否适用于朝鲜人的争论中，关键争点在于朝鲜人是否为日本臣民、间岛是否属于南满。
朝鲜总督府详细阐述了日本在朝鲜人问题上的立场。在1915年6月至8月向日本外务省提出的申诉中，朝鲜总督府论证说：日本对朝鲜的吞并已使朝鲜人成为日本臣民，而日本对间岛与南满朝鲜人的行政管辖权不对称，将妨碍对满洲朝鲜人抗日活动的有效镇压。总督府预计，日本对间岛朝鲜人司法管辖权的缺失，将为流亡的朝鲜独立运动提供庇护所。
en: Despite this ambiguity, China was forced to defend the Kando Treaty by default in order to prevent Japan from asserting the extraterritoriality of Japanese subjects. Although the 1915 Treaty concerned South Manchuria and Mongolia, Japan insisted on extending it to Kando, which was often referred to as East Manchuria. Thus, the 1915 Treaty would grant Koreans extraterritoriality, which had been precluded by the Kando Treaty. In disputes over the applicability of the 1915 Treaty to Koreans, a key contention concerned whether Koreans were Japanese subjects and whether Kando was part of South Manchuria.

The Government General of Korea elaborated on the Japanese standpoint on Koreans. In an appeal to the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs from June to August of 1915, the Government General of Korea reasoned that Japan’s annexation of Korea converted Koreans into Japanese subjects and that asymmetrical Japanese administrative authority over Koreans in Kando and South Manchuria would thwart the effective suppression of the anti-Japanese activities of Koreans in Manchuria. It projected that the absence of Japan’s judicial authority over Koreans in Kando would provide a sanctuary for the exiled Korean independence movement.

zh: 在间岛总领事的支持下，朝鲜总督府要求日本外务省以1915年关于日本臣民治外法权的协议，取代宣告中国对间岛朝鲜人拥有行政与司法管辖权的《间岛协约》第3、4、5款。这一申诉援引了1915年条约第8款，该款废止此前的一切条约。日本外务省起初为了与中国建立较为和缓的关系，反对朝鲜总督府的提议，其异议依据的是朝鲜人与日本臣民的区分：前者适用《间岛协约》，后者适用1915年条约。然而1915年8月，由首相兼任外务大臣的日本内阁批准了朝鲜总督府的提议，并向北京政府施压，要求其同意。中华民国政府提出反驳，声明1915年条约涉及的是南满与日本臣民，而非间岛的朝鲜人。
en: With the support of the consul general in Kando, the Government General of Korea asked that the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs substitute the 1915 accord on extraterritoriality of Japanese subjects for Articles 3, 4, and 5 of the Kando treaty, which proclaimed Chinese administrative and judicial authority over Koreans in Kando. This appeal cited Article 8 of the 1915 Treaty, which annulled all preceding treaties. The Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs initially opposed the Government General of Korea’s proposal so as to initiate conciliatory relations with China. Its objection drew on the distinction of Koreans and Japanese subjects, the former subject to the Kando Treaty and the latter to the 1915 Treaty. However, in August 1915 the Japanese Cabinet, in which the prime minister also served as the head of the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, endorsed the Government General of Korea’s proposal and pressed the Beijing government to consent to it. The Chinese Republican government issued a challenge, stating that the 1915 Treaty concerned South Manchuria and Japanese subjects, not Koreans in Kando.

zh: 《间岛协约》与1915年条约分别保障了日本渗透政治的两个不同前提——土地所有权与朝鲜人的治外法权。对两项条约似是而非的适用，使日本获得了渗透政治的工具。日本使用含混而闪烁的地理指称，以示对中国抗议的蔑视。在1915年条约中，日本引入南满、北满乃至偶尔东满之类的满洲地域范畴，取代中国奉天、黑龙江、吉林三省的行政范畴。日本坚持间岛属于南满，撤销了《间岛协约》中三项有争议的条款，同时保留协约规定的朝鲜人土地所有权，并命令其驻满洲领事馆对朝鲜人行使司法权。1915年主张间岛朝鲜人治外法权的举动，确认了保护朝鲜人的策略——日本早已把它确定为替代间岛领土权利的方案。1931年以前，中日之间围绕领土主权的重新交涉与资本主义发展相互叠合，并在《间岛协约》塑造的新政治语境中展开。
en: The Kando and 1915 Treaties both guaranteed the disparate prerequisites of Japan’s osmotic politics—landownership and the extraterritoriality of Koreans. The specious adoption of both treaties equipped Japan with the tools of osmotic politics. Japan displayed its defiance of Chinese objections by using imprecise and evasive geographical references. In the 1915 Treaty, Japan introduced regional categories for Manchuria, such as South, North, and occasionally East Manchuria, instead of using China’s administrative categories of Fengtian, Heilongjiang, and Jilin Provinces. Insisting that Kando was part of South Manchuria, Japan revoked three disputed provisions of the Kando Treaty while retaining landownership for Koreans prescribed by the Kando Treaty. It ordered its consulates in Manchuria to apply their juridical rights over Koreans. The move to assert the extraterritoriality of Koreans in Kando in 1915 affirmed the strategy of protecting Koreans, which Japan had identified earlier as an alternative to territorial rights over Kando. Prior to 1931, the renegotiation between China and Japan over territorial sovereignty was imbricated with capitalist development and took place within a new political context shaped by the Kando Treaty.

zh: 对抗性的三角政治
en: confrontational triangular politics

zh: 间岛的民族政治与殖民政治转向日本、间岛政府与朝鲜人之间的对抗关系。间岛政治经济格局的一个显著特征，是在奉天省民族政治中发挥关键作用的有实力的中国商人的缺席。取而代之的是，日本资本使间岛的中国与朝鲜商人处于从属地位，让他们充当农民生产者与日本买主、贸易商之间的中介。由于《间岛协约》赋予日本在间岛四个主要城市贸易与投资的权利，日本资本迅速涌入，进而垄断了贸易、出口与金融部门。日本在间岛的经济支配，被描述为不只是一种干预，更确切地说，是一块吸走间岛财富的海绵。
日本贸易公司雇用中国与朝鲜商人，到乡间向农民收购作物，运往城市，再卖给日本贸易公司。这些公司不仅把作物分销给粮栈与食品加工厂（豆油、豆饼加工厂，面粉厂等），还经南满铁路将其出口到朝鲜、日本与欧洲。
en: National and colonial politics in Kando veered toward confrontational relations among Japan, the Kando Administration, and Koreans. The political and economic landscape in Kando was marked by the absence of the powerful Chinese merchants who had played a key role in national politics in Fengtian Province. Instead, Japanese capital subordinated Chinese and Korean merchants in Kando, making them mediators between peasant producers and Japanese buyers and traders. Since the Kando Treaty granted Japan the rights to trade and invest in four major cities in Kando, Japanese capital quickly flooded in and came to monopolize trade, exports, and the financial sector. Japan’s economic domination in Kando has been depicted not just as an intervention but also, more aptly, as a sponge soaking up the wealth of Kando.

Japanese trading companies hired Chinese and Korean merchants to buy crops from farmers in the countryside, transport them to urban areas, and sell them to Japanese trading companies. The companies not only distributed these crops to grain stores and food-processing factories (bean oil and bean cake processors, flour mills, and so forth) but also exported them via the South Manchuria Railway to Korea, Japan, and Europe.

zh: 日本商人与金融机构支配了金融部门。朝鲜银行、东洋拓殖株式会社的分支机构（也称间岛救济会，朝鲜语Kando kujehoe）、兴农合资会社（Hungnong Joint Company）等组织，如同巨型当铺般运作。它们向个体商人与农民放贷，并为抵押而对房屋及其他财产估定资产价值。事实上，日本金融组织提供低息贷款，成为朝鲜与中国商人、农民可获贷款的主要来源，并最终吞并了朝鲜人经营的信用组织。此外，日本货币自由流通，比币值剧烈波动的中国货币更受青睐。
中国的金融组织，如东北三省官银号分号与吉林永衡官银号分号，主要从事本行所发货币的兑换与异地款项运解，很少向个体农民放贷。
en: Japanese merchants and financial institutions dominated the financial sector. Organizations such as the Choson Bank, a branch of the Oriental Development Company (known as the Kando Relief Association, Kando kujehoe), and the Hungnong Joint Company operated as giant pawnbrokers. Lending money to individual merchants and peasants, these organizations assigned asset values to houses and other properties for mortgages. In fact, Japanese financial organizations offered low-interest loans and became a major source of loans available to Korean and Chinese merchants and peasants. These organizations eventually absorbed the credit organizations run by Koreans. Furthermore, Japanese currency circulated freely and was favored over Chinese currency, whose value fluctuated widely.

Chinese financial organizations, such as a branch of the Official Bank of the Three Northeastern Provinces and a branch of Jilin Yonghung Official Bank, mainly engaged in exchanging the currencies their banks issued and transporting money between places. These institutions rarely loaned money to individual peasants.

zh: 间岛的抗日政治在对抗性框架中展开。由于中国资产阶级软弱，中国方面的关键政治角色是间岛政府。因为与日本存在间岛领土争端，间岛政府不仅与直属上级吉林省政府保持直接联系，也与北京的中国外交部直接沟通——即便在1920年代张作霖控制吉林及满洲其他地区时也是如此。间岛政府推行把朝鲜人纳入中国人共同体的政策，诱导他们入籍并采用满族与中国的风俗。
en: Anti-Japanese politics in Kando unfolded within a confrontational framework. With a weak Chinese bourgeoisie, the key political player on the Chinese side was the Kando Administration. Because of territorial disputes with Japan over Kando, the Kando Administration was in direct communication not just with the Jilin provincial government, its immediate superior, but also with the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Beijing, even in the 1920s, when Zhang Zuolin gained control over Jilin and other parts of Manchuria. The Kando Administration enacted policies to integrate Koreans into the Chinese community, coaxing them to become naturalized and adopt Manchu and Chinese customs.

zh: 朝鲜人作为枢要的政治角色登场。由于日本与地方政府争夺对他们的控制权，朝鲜人不仅是被动员的对象，也在间岛形成了一股政治力量。这一发展与南满朝鲜人的政治立场较为模糊形成对照：在南满，他们既不抗议日本对他们提出的权利主张（奉天省称为东边道的边境地区除外），也不要求中国当局减轻对朝鲜人的压迫（东北三省已入籍朝鲜人的代表提交的几份请愿除外）。相反，间岛的朝鲜人把该地区发展为朝鲜独立运动的据点。1910年代，非共产主义的民族主义团体主导政治，倡导朝鲜人教育并组织游击部队。
1920年秋的珲春县屠杀——日本为报复流亡朝鲜人的抵抗，大规模处决了6,000多名朝鲜平民——标志着间岛内外朝鲜独立运动的转折点。屠杀之后，朝鲜民族主义者逃往北满与东边道地区，1920年代间岛的共产主义活动随之增加。日本警察部队与军队在镇压朝鲜人抵抗时，继续无视中国主权。
en: Koreans emerged as pivotal political players. As Japan and local governments competed for control over them, Koreans were not merely objects of mobilization but also formed a political force in Kando. This development was in contrast to the ambiguous politics of Koreans in South Manchuria, where they neither protested Japanese claims on them (except in the border area of Fengtian Province called Tongbyŏndo) nor demanded that Chinese authorities ease the oppression of Koreans (except for a few petitions submitted by the representatives of naturalized Koreans of three northeast provinces). On the contrary, Koreans in Kando developed the region as a site of the Korean independence movement. Noncommunist nationalist groups dominated politics in the 1910s, advocating education for Koreans and operating guerrilla armies.

The massacre in Hunch’un County in the autumn of 1920, where Japan retaliated against exiled Korean resistance with a mass execution of more than 6,000 Korean civilians, marked a turning point in the Korean independence movement within and beyond Kando. After the massacre, Korean nationalists fled to North Manchuria and the Tongbyŏndo area, and communist activities in Kando increased during the 1920s. Japanese police forces and armies continued to disregard Chinese sovereignty in their suppression of Korean resistance.

zh: 间岛政府与日本领事馆继续就联合镇压朝鲜独立运动进行交涉。间岛政府意图根除那些招致日本警察与军队行动的朝鲜人抵抗活动。间岛政府长官招募新警察，甚至请求日本为其提供武装。
然而，他们的联合行动在间岛不如在南满、尤其是东边道地区那样有力。更重要的是，中国官员试图把朝鲜人纳入其民族共同体。这种中国民族政治伴随着间岛朝鲜人对中国的友好态度。日中之间的竞争沿这两条路线分裂了朝鲜人的民族政治。
en: The Kando Administration and Japanese consulates continued to negotiate their collective pacification of the Korean independence movement. The Kando Administration intended to root out those Korean resistance activities that led to Japanese police and military exercises. The head of the Kando Administration recruited new police and even asked Japan to arm them.

However, their joint operation was less forceful in Kando than in South Manchuria, especially the Tongbyŏndo region. More importantly, Chinese officials attempted to integrate Koreans into its national community. This Chinese national politics was accompanied by the favorable attitude of Koreans of Kando toward China. The rivalry between Japan and China divided Koreans’ national politics along these two lines.

zh: 事实殖民
en: de facto colonization

zh: 社会主权
en: Social Sovereignty

zh: 对抗性政治使日本得以在间岛做出大胆的侵蚀。行政与金融附属机构使日本领事馆能够对朝鲜人、乃至对间岛本身确立事实上的主权。这种主权植根于社会关系。东洋拓殖株式会社通过与朝鲜人发展社会纽带，为渗透扩张做出贡献。东洋拓殖株式会社1908年在东京设立总部，1918年在间岛开设分社，吸收了朝鲜总督府1911年创建的表面目的为救助龙井市火灾灾民的组织——间岛救济会。该公司在投资电力、矿业等产业的同时，成为朝鲜人不可或缺的金融服务提供者。1928年，其间岛分社把总额230万圆的投资约半数用于贷款。公司贷款的年利率因担保类型而异：土地抵押贷款为8.2%，房屋或未来收成等动产抵押贷款为10.2%。这些年利率低于其他金融组织收取的17%至30%，以及高利贷者的40%至70%。

children: 〔校注〕此处将东洋拓殖株式会社间岛分社开设年记为 1918 年。第一章记为 1917 年，两处都沿用底本。

en: Confrontational politics prepared Japan to make audacious encroachments in Kando. Administrative and financial subsidiaries enabled Japanese consulates to establish de facto sovereign power over Koreans and over Kando itself. Japan’s sovereign power was anchored in social relations. The Oriental Development Company contributed to osmotic expansion by developing social ties with Koreans. Establishing its headquarters in Tokyo in 1908, the Oriental Development Company opened its branch in 1918 in Kando, absorbing the Kando Relief Association that the Government General of Korea created in 1911 ostensibly to assist fire victims in Ryongjŏng city. While the company invested in industries such as electrical power and mining, it became an indispensable provider of financial services to Koreans. In 1928, its Kando branch expended about half of its total 2.3 million won of investment on loans. The annual interest rate of loans made by the company differed by the type of security, with 8.2 percent for loans guaranteed by land and 10.2 percent by movable assets such as a house or future harvest. These annual interest rates were lower than the 17 to 30 percent rates charged by other financial organizations and 40 to 70 percent rates of usurers.

zh: 正如东亚劝业株式会社在南满所做的那样，东洋拓殖株式会社通过在违约情况下没收抵押土地来积累土地。公司在间岛拥有的土地数量为58,170亩，其中约五分之四为水田。东洋拓殖株式会社的做法因借款人的国籍而异，反映了中国政府对公司取得土地的抵制。中国借款人未能偿还贷款时，公司须把担保土地转让给中国政府，由政府向债务人或佃农收取部分收成以偿还贷款。朝鲜人土地所有者以土地作抵押时，公司通常保留地契或租约。朝鲜人债务人未能偿还贷款时，公司便没收土地，再租给佃农耕种。
en: As the Asia Development Company had done in South Manchuria, the Oriental Development Company accumulated land by confiscating mortgaged land in cases of default. The amount of land owned by the company in Kando was 58,170 mu, about four-fifths of which was rice fields. The practices of the Oriental Development Company differed according to the borrower’s nationality, reflecting the resistance of the Chinese government to the company’s acquisition of land. When Chinese borrowers failed to repay loans, the company was required to transfer the guaranteed land to the Chinese government, which then collected a portion of the harvest from the debtor or the tenants to repay the loans. When Korean landowners used land as collateral, the company usually kept the title or the leasing contract. When Korean debtors failed to repay their loans, the company seized the land and hired tenants to cultivate it.

zh: 在领事馆警察部门的监督下，朝鲜人民会使得日本领事馆能够培育与朝鲜人的社会纽带，并渗透朝鲜人的日常生活。间岛的朝鲜人民会与日本领事馆的社会关系，比满洲其他地区更为紧密。1917年，领事馆开始改组间岛的附属朝鲜人组织。由于朝鲜人民会与朝鲜人居留民会（Chosŏnin kŏryuminhoe）会员人数偏低，改组试图协调各组织并扩大其社会基础。
改组的主旨是把朝鲜人民会发展为一个具有公共地位、可以强制朝鲜人入会的组织。1917年5月，间岛总领事谈到这次改组预期带来的好处：
en: Supervised by consular police departments, the Korean Association enabled Japanese consulates to cultivate social ties with Koreans and penetrate the everyday lives of Koreans. The Korean Association fostered closer social relationships with the Japanese consulates in Kando than in other parts of Manchuria. In 1917, the consulates began to restructure the subsidiary Korean organizations in Kando. As the Korean Association and the Korean Residents’ Association (Chosŏnin kŏryuminhoe) suffered from low membership, the restructuring attempted to coordinate the organizations and expand their social bases.

The thrust of the restructuring was to develop the Korean Association as a public organization capable of forcing the compulsory participation of Koreans. In May 1917, the consul general in Kando spoke of the anticipated benefits of this restructuring:

zh: 当日中就1915年条约是否凌驾于《间岛协约》某些条款的问题争执不下时，中国当局开始把朝鲜人纳入中国社会。如果我们忽视这一局势，它可能使朝鲜人逐渐摆脱日本帝国官员的控制。……间岛的朝鲜人分为亲日与亲中两派。……设想中的朝鲜人组织的公共地位，不仅会使入会成为义务，还会给那些惧怕中国报复的朝鲜人提供加入这些组织的正当理由。此外，朝鲜人组织的公共地位将使征收会费获得授权。
en: As China and Japan contended over the issue of whether the 1915 Treaty overrides some provisions of the Kando Treaty, Chinese authorities began to integrate Koreans into Chinese society. If we neglect this situation, it could gradually detach Koreans from Japanese imperial officials. . . . Koreans in Kando are divided into pro-Japanese and pro-Chinese groups. . . . The public status of the envisaged Korean organizations would not only make membership obligatory but also would offer practical excuses for joining the organizations to Koreans who are fearful of Chinese retaliation. Furthermore, the public status of Korean organizations would authorize the collection of membership fees.

zh: 1916年至1920年间，间岛共设立了十八个朝鲜人民会分会。一些分会在1919年3月13日的抗日抗议中被解散，但后来恢复了活动。
朝鲜人民会整合了其他组织。虽然满洲其他地区也存在几个该会分会，但其运作远远落后于间岛的同行。直到1935年，新成立的全朝鲜人民会联合会（Chonsŏnin minhoe yŏnhaphoe）才整合了满洲其他地区的朝鲜人民会。
en: From 1916 to 1920, a total of eighteen branches of the Korean Association were established in Kando. Some were dismantled during anti-Japanese protests on March 13, 1919, but were later resurrected.

The Korean Association integrated other organizations. Although a few branches of the association existed in other parts of Manchuria, their operations lagged far behind those of their counterparts in Kando. It was not until 1935 that the new Federation of the Korean Association (Chonsŏnin minhoe yŏnhaphoe) integrated the Korean Association in other parts of Manchuria.

zh: 由于朝鲜人民会是领事馆的辅助组织，日本外务省原则上负责资助其主要活动。朝鲜总督府向朝鲜人民会提供补助时，其用途是支付面向朝鲜人的其他活动，如公共教育与卫生。
至于代表日本领事馆开展的主要工作，朝鲜人民会执行命令，并对朝鲜人的原籍家世、财产状况、耕地面积与经济状况进行调查。

它对朝鲜人实施日常监视，以削弱流亡独立运动的影响，并防止其蔓延到朝鲜。朝鲜人民会核查拜访朝鲜人家庭的亲属及其他人的身份，严密审查朝鲜人的集会与活动。它向居民签发前往朝鲜的旅行许可证，以防止间岛与朝鲜的游击队员和民族主义者相互接触。朝鲜人民会使日本领事馆警察足不出户就能监视朝鲜人中的抗日活动。1920年代末，Shim Yŏch'u就该会无孔不入的活动作证说：“不加入朝鲜人民会的朝鲜人会被怀疑反抗日本。反华态度在日常生活中无关紧要，但一旦被扣上反日的帽子，连一天都难以忍受。仅仅表达反日态度，就可能立即遭到日本警察逮捕。”
这种不断扩张的对朝鲜人的管控权，促使中国官员谴责朝鲜人民会干涉中国行政主权。
en: Since the Korean Association was the auxiliary organization of the consulates, the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs was responsible in principle for subsidizing their major activities. When the Government General of Korea offered subsidies to the Korean Association, they were intended to pay for other activities for Koreans such as public education and hygiene.

As for its primary work on behalf of the Japanese consulates, the Korean Association enforced orders and conducted surveys of Koreans on family origins, property ownership, amounts of land under cultivation, and economic conditions.

It carried out daily surveillance of Koreans so as to curtail the influence of the exiled independence movements and to prevent them from spreading to Korea. The Korean Association checked the identities of relatives and others visiting Korean households and scrutinized the meetings and activities of Koreans. It issued permits to residents for travel to Korea in order to prevent contacts among the partisans and nationalists in Kando and Korea. The Korean Association enabled the police of the Japanese consulates to monitor anti-Japanese activities among Koreans without leaving their offices. Shim Yŏch’u in the late 1920s testified about the overarching activities of the association: “Koreans who do not join the Korean Association are suspected of defying Japan. While anti-Chinese attitudes do not matter much in daily life, being implicated as anti-Japanese makes even one day unbearable. The mere expression of an anti-Japanese attitude can lead to immediate arrest by Japanese police.”
This expansive authority over Koreans prompted Chinese officials to denounce the Korean Association for interfering with Chinese administrative sovereignty.

zh: 该会在朝鲜人日常生活中的无处不在，持续引发历史学家的兴趣。朝鲜人民会的活动使简单的“亲日”定性难以成立。

韩国历史学家Lim Yŏngsŏ把朝鲜人民会描述为既服务于日本领事馆的辅助单位，又是推动朝鲜人自治的团体。Lim关于该会是自治组织的论断，依据的是朝鲜人民会的领导层与活动同其他著名亲日组织——尤其是奉天省与朝鲜边境的保民会（Pominhoe）——之间的对比。朝鲜人民会的领导层由许多没有明显为日本效力背景的学校教师组成。而保民会的领导层则主要包括臭名昭著的亲日组织一进会的前成员，该组织曾主张日本吞并朝鲜。这种领导层背景使人难以判定朝鲜人民会是否完全亲日。朝鲜人民会的主要领导人在日本吞并朝鲜之前就已移居满洲，这一事实似乎使他们把对朝鲜人共同体的关切置于朝鲜解放之上。此外，朝鲜人民会致力于消除危及朝鲜人居住与耕作的中国压迫，而保民会则以根除流亡朝鲜人运动为目标。在Lim的分析中，朝鲜人民会的这种共同体性质由其参与1923年自治运动得到确证。
en: The ubiquitous presence of the association in the everyday lives of Koreans continues to generate interest among historians. The activities of the Korean Association belied simple qualification of pro-Japanese.

Lim Yŏngsŏ, a South Korean historian, describes the Korean Association as an auxiliary unit serving Japanese consulates and a group promoting self-rule for Koreans. Lim’s suggestion that the association was a self-rule organization draws on the contrast between the leadership and activities of the Korean Association and those of other prominent pro-Japanese organizations, especially the Association for the Protection of Koreans (Pominhoe) on the border of Fengtian Province and Korea. The leadership of the Korean Association was made up of many schoolteachers who did not have obvious backgrounds working for Japan. However, the leadership of the Association for the Protection of Koreans mainly included former members of the infamous pro-Japanese organization Ilchinhoe, which advocated the annexation of Korea by Japan. This leadership background makes it difficult to determine whether the Korean Association was entirely pro-Japanese. The fact that the major leaders of the Korean Association migrated to Manchuria before the annexation of Korea by Japan seemed to lead them to prioritize their concern for the Korean community over the liberation of Korea. Moreover, the Korean Association was geared toward eliminating the Chinese oppression that jeopardized residence and farming for Koreans, while the Association for the Protection of Koreans aimed to eradicate the exiled Korean movements. In Lim’s analysis, this community character of the Korean Association is affirmed by their participation in the self-rule movement in 1923.

zh: 尽管Lim的分析是探索朝鲜人民会复杂性质的重要尝试，它仍不完整。改善朝鲜人社会生活不仅是朝鲜人民会的口号，也是保民会的口号。然而，理解朝鲜人组织的关键问题不在于它们是否寻求改善朝鲜人的社会生活，而在于这样一个事实：改善社会生活的号召，正是日本以“保护”朝鲜人为名进行渗透扩张的核心。向朝鲜人分配土地是渗透扩张最基本的要素，保民会的一位创建者在1923年对此表述得十分清楚：“日本若不照顾依靠农耕为生的朝鲜人的生计，就无法对朝鲜人确立主权。……日本向贫穷朝鲜人分配土地，不仅有助于稳定朝鲜人的生计，也会使日本富裕。届时满洲将不仅属于朝鲜人，也属于日本。”
他在1924年重申，日本不仅能靠军事手段，还能通过对土地开垦的投资赢得亚洲人的支持。
en: Although Lim’s analysis is a significant attempt to explore the intricate nature of the Korean Association, it remains incomplete. Improving the social life of Koreans was a motto not just for the Korean Association but also for the Association for the Protection of Koreans. However, the crucial issue for understanding Korean organizations is not whether they sought to enhance Korean social life. Instead, it is the fact that the call for improving social life was the crux of Japan’s osmotic expansion in the name of “protecting” Koreans. Distributing land to Koreans was the most basic element of osmotic expansion, as a founder of the Association for the Protection of Koreans clearly articulated in 1923: “Japan cannot establish sovereignty over Koreans, unless it attends to the livelihood of Koreans depending on farming. . . . The distribution of land to poor Koreans by Japan would not only help stabilize Koreans’ livelihood but also enrich Japan. Manchuria will then belong to not just Koreans but also Japan.”
He reiterated in 1924 that Japan could win the support of Asians not merely by military means but also through its investment in land reclamation.

zh: 朝鲜人组织共有的共同体取向，体现了日本的渗透策略。改善农民生活的承诺使日本得以把其权力嵌入朝鲜人的社会生活。与东洋拓殖株式会社一道，朝鲜人民会的信用组合执行了保护朝鲜人的政策。1920年，它利用日本军队在珲春屠杀后提供的资金，以及朝鲜总督府的拨款开设了五个信用组合。它们向贫困农民提供低息贷款，帮助支付农具与土地的购置费用。信用组合把个人贷款限额定为100圆，日息0.05%。
年利率定为16.2%，高于东洋拓殖株式会社收取的8.2%至10.2%，但远低于高利贷者的60%至72%。由于朝鲜人民会的信用组合把借款人登记为会员，一些获得贷款的人甚至没有意识到自己是该会会员。

children: 〔校注〕原书日息0.05%折合年息约18.25%，与同段印本年息16.2%不符（已核印本第106页），两处数字均照印保留。

en: The community orientation shared by Korean organizations signified Japan’s osmotic strategy. The promise to improve the lives of peasants enabled Japan to embed its power in the social life of Koreans. Together with the Oriental Development Company, the credit unions of the Korean Association carried out the policy of protecting Koreans. In 1920, it opened five credit unions with funds from both the Japanese armies after the Hunch’un massacre and the Government General of Korea. They offered low-interest loans to destitute farmers to help pay for the purchase of farming tools and land. The credit unions limited the amount of individual loans to 100 won with 0.05 percent daily interest.

They set the annual interest rate at 16.2 percent, which was higher than the 8.2 to 10.2 percent charged by the Oriental Development Company but much lower than the 60 to 72 percent charged by usurers. Since the Korean Association’s credit unions enrolled borrowers as members, some loan recipients did not even realize they were members of the association.

zh: 东洋拓殖株式会社与朝鲜人民会服务于广泛的朝鲜人群体。前者服务于拥有财产的人，后者服务于没有财产的人。如前所述，前者为能够抵押土地或其他动产的朝鲜人有产者提供了大部分贷款。相比之下，朝鲜人民会向长期负债的贫穷朝鲜人放贷。朝鲜总督府承认，信用组合的财力仍太小，不足以帮助间岛全部30万朝鲜人，但朝鲜人民会仍是向贫困者提供贷款的中心金融机构。
这些贷款往往用于偿还其他贷款，包括东洋拓殖株式会社发放的贷款。例如1933年朝鲜人民会向14,403名朝鲜人提供了747,092圆，其中贷款总额的53%用于偿还旧债，只有0.23%用于购地或农业改良。
en: The Oriental Development Company and the Korean Association serviced a broad range of Koreans. The former served those who owned property and the latter served those without property. As noted earlier, the former financed most of the loans to Korean property owners who could mortgage land or other movable assets. In contrast, the Korean Association made loans to poor Koreans who were in chronic debt. The Government General of Korea acknowledged that the financial capacity of the credit unions was still too small to help all 300,000 Koreans in Kando, yet the Korean Association was a central financial institution that provided loans to the destitute.

These loans were often used to repay other loans, including those made by the Oriental Development Company. When the Korean Association, for instance, provided 747,092 won to 14,403 Koreans in 1933, 53 percent of a total amount of loans was spent on paying old debts and only 0.23 percent went toward purchasing land or making agricultural improvements.

zh: 日本金融机构及其机制把日本权力与朝鲜人之间的关系，塑造成以资本交换为中介的社会关系。它们的社会纽带需要一种超出“亲日”或“殖民”定性的具体理解。这种关系并不单纯建立在对日本帝国的种族与政治认同之上。向朝鲜人土地所有者与贫穷农民发放的贷款，必须被理解为远不止日本资本投资的东西。它们是日本渗透政治的工具。金融机构与警察力量、行政代理人携手，推进了帝国的渗透扩张。
en: Japanese financial apparatuses fashioned the relationships between Japanese power and Koreans into social relations mediated by the exchange of capital. Their social ties warrant a specific understanding beyond their designation as pro-Japanese or colonial. Their relationship was not built solely on racial and political identification with the Japanese empire. Loans made to Korean landowners and poor peasants must be understood as much more than Japanese capital investment. They were a tool of Japan’s osmotic politics. Financial institutions advanced the osmotic expansion of the empire hand in hand with the police force and the administrative agents.

zh: 对间岛的宗主权
en: Suzerainty over Kando

zh: 领事馆把日本的社会主权从朝鲜人扩展到间岛。日本领事馆警察逮捕已入籍成为中国国民的朝鲜人。朝鲜人承认领事馆为事实上的统治权力，足证日本的宗主权。例如，当中国警察试图逮捕违反中国禁酿米酒法律的朝鲜人时，朝鲜人袭击了警察，并把他们扭送到日本领事馆。当一个朝鲜人放贷者向日本领事馆起诉保证人时，领事馆官员裁定保证人与债务人必须卖掉牛和猪来偿债。
当珲春县的中国官员把一批从朝鲜走私食盐的朝鲜人投入监狱时，朝鲜人越狱后到日本领事馆寻求庇护。

1920年代末，推动朝鲜人入籍与自治的Shim Yŏch'u痛切地观察到日本领事馆在朝鲜人日常生活中非同寻常的重要性。由于语言障碍，以及怀疑中国官员偏袒中国农民，朝鲜人更愿意向日本领事而非中国官员申诉。中国县知事与警察局长要求间岛政府与日本交涉、终止领事的司法实践，但徒劳无功。据Shim所说，中国禁止领事司法活动的企图使包括共产主义者在内的朝鲜民族主义者高兴，却使普通朝鲜人担心失去申诉冤屈的地方。
en: The consulates extended Japan’s social sovereignty from Koreans to Kando. Japanese consular policemen arrested Koreans who had become naturalized as Chinese nationals. Japan’s suzerainty is attested by the Koreans’ recognition of the consulates as the de facto governing power. For example, when Chinese policemen attempted to arrest Korean violators of a Chinese law that banned the brewing of rice wine, Koreans assaulted the policemen and brought them to the Japanese consulates. When a Korean moneylender filed a suit with the Japanese consulate against a guarantor, consular officials ruled that the guarantor and the debtor must pay the debt by selling their cows and pigs.
When Chinese officials in Hunch’un County imprisoned a group of Koreans for smuggling salt from Korea, the Koreans escaped and found refuge in a Japanese consulate.

In the late 1920s, Shim Yŏch’u, a promoter of Korean naturalization and self-rule, observed poignantly the idiosyncratic importance of Japanese consulates in the daily lives of Koreans. Koreans confided in Japanese consuls rather than Chinese officials because of the language barrier and their suspicion that they favored Chinese peasants. Chinese county magistrates and police chiefs requested in vain that the Kando Administration negotiate with Japan to terminate the juridical practices of the consuls. According to Shim, the Chinese attempt to ban consuls’ judicial activities pleased Korean nationalists, including the communists, but left ordinary Koreans worried about losing a place to file their grievances.

zh: 朝鲜人的抗日活动助长了日本利用渗透政治确立主权。朝鲜人居住与拥有土地的合法权利，为流亡朝鲜人政治铺平了道路。1920年代中期，办学与为新到朝鲜人提供互助项目等温和民族主义活动衰落，激进的共产主义活动则占据上风。朝鲜共产党满洲总局虽在全满洲设立，其活动成果最丰的地方却是间岛。满洲总局间岛支部于1920年初组织了拥有数千名成员的东满共产主义青年同盟与农民同盟。
朝鲜共产主义者从事游击活动，暗杀日本当局人员，破坏包括日本领事馆在内的战略建筑与桥梁。

children: 〔校注〕印本作“in early 1920”（1920年初，已核印本第107页）。朝鲜共产党1925年方成立，其满洲总局间岛支部不可能于1920年初组织东满共产主义青年同盟与农民同盟，疑印本年代有误，照译存疑。

en: The anti-Japanese activities of Koreans emboldened Japan’s use of osmotic politics for establishing sovereignty. The legal rights of Koreans to reside and own land paved the way for exiled Korean politics. Whereas moderate nationalist activities, such as the operation of schools and mutual aid programs for newly arrived Koreans, waned in the mid-1920s, radical communist activities became ascendant. Although the Manchuria General Bureau of the Korean Communist Party was established across Manchuria, its activities yielded the most fruit in Kando. The Kando branch of the Manchuria Bureau organized the East Manchuria Young Men’s League of Communist Youth and the Farmers League in early 1920 with several thousand members.
Korean Communists engaged in guerrilla activities, assassinating Japanese authorities and destroying strategic buildings and bridges, including Japanese consulates.

zh: 朝鲜共产主义者的活动意味着渗透过程中传输受阻，即“渗漏”，而日本权力利用这一点推进渗透过程。以镇压朝鲜人运动为名，日本警察与军队频繁搜查住宅与组织、逮捕朝鲜人，其中许多人被押送到朝鲜北部的监狱审讯与惩戒。1920年代中期，日本已抛弃尊重中国权威的任何伪装。对这些搜捕行动，它即便事后也很少通知中国官员。它甚至宣称间岛是朝鲜北部咸镜道的一部分。虽然一些朝鲜人试图通过入籍中国寻求保护，以躲避日本的迫害，但这一策略无效，因为日本不承认已入籍的朝鲜人是中国公民。出于对共产主义蔓延的恐惧，并为先发制人地阻止日本进一步的行动，该地区的中国官员甚至与日本合作镇压朝鲜人的民族主义与抗日活动。日本声称，其针对朝鲜人的行动源于对间岛独立运动蔓延到朝鲜半岛的担忧。然而日本的渗透政治表明，日本怀有更广泛的野心。
en: The activities of the Korean communists denoted a failure in osmotic transfusion, or “leakage,” which Japanese power exploited to advance the osmotic process. In the name of suppressing Korean movements, Japanese police and armies frequently searched houses and organizations and arrested Koreans, many of whom were transported for interrogation and discipline to prisons in northern Korea. In the mid-1920s, Japan had dropped any pretense of respecting Chinese authority. It seldom informed Chinese officials of these sweeps until afterward, if at all. It even proclaimed Kando to be part of northern Korea’s Hamgyŏng Province. Although some Koreans sought protection against Japanese persecution by becoming naturalized as Chinese, this strategy was ineffective because Japan did not recognize naturalized Koreans as Chinese citizens. Fearing the spread of communism and seeking to preempt further Japanese campaigns, the Chinese officials in the region even collaborated with Japan in subduing the Koreans’ nationalist and anti-Japanese activities. Japan asserted that its campaigns against Koreans resulted from its concern that the independence movements in Kando would spread to the Korean Peninsula. Yet Japanese osmotic politics revealed that Japan had broader ambitions.

zh: 在日本人与朝鲜人的对抗中，反共主义充当了排除性的殖民话语，一种界定并规训不忠臣民的政治差异修辞。日本宣称1930年代的世界政治是共产主义与反共主义阵营之间的战争，把自己与德国、意大利等盟友归入反共阵营，把敌人归入共产主义阵营，甚至把美国、英国、法国描绘成共产主义国家。这种反共主义服务于日本在朝鲜与满洲的目的。它试图遏制民族运动的蔓延，尤其是民族解放运动与共产主义者的联盟——后者在1928年朝鲜共产党解散前后也流亡满洲。日本把激进抵抗团体归类为共产主义者，认为他们拒绝私有财产、鼓吹暴力革命、削弱日本精神。这帮助日本把反殖民抵抗框定为朝鲜人内部的阶级冲突。朝鲜总督府颁布一系列反共法律，建立数千个反共协会，并为警察主办的众多集会动员数百万朝鲜人。
这些反共运动不限于朝鲜，还延伸到满洲，为日本在间岛凌驾中国权威提供了借口。
en: During the confrontations between the Japanese and Koreans, anticommunism served as a colonial discourse of exclusion, a trope of political difference that defined and disciplined disloyal subjects. Declaring that world politics in the 1930s engaged in wars between communist and anticommunist blocs, Japan lumped itself and its allies, such as Germany and Italy, into an anticommunist bloc, while grouping its enemies in a communist bloc, even portraying the United States, Great Britain, and France as communist. This anticommunism served Japan’s ends in Korea and Manchuria. It sought to contain the spread of national movements, especially the alliance of the national liberation movement and the communists who also were exiled in Manchuria before and after the dissolution of the Korean Communist Party in 1928. Japan classified radical resistance groups as communist, who were thought to reject private property, promote violent revolution, and debilitate the Japanese spirit. This helped Japan frame anticolonial resistance as a form of class conflict among Koreans. The Government General of Korea promulgated a series of anticommunist laws, established thousands of anti-communist associations, and mobilized millions of Koreans for numerous police-sponsored gatherings.
These anti-Communist campaigns were not confined to Korea but extended to Manchuria, supplying Japan with an excuse to override Chinese authority in Kando.

zh: 保护被日本当局认定为“良民”的朝鲜人免受不良分子侵害的策略在这一地区富有成效。日本承诺保护朝鲜人免受激进叛乱者侵害，扩充警察部队并使其装备得能像军队一样运作。
日本斥责中国官员强迫朝鲜人入籍，并因朝鲜人与日本人来往而对其报复。日本领事馆还谴责中国官员未能遏制朝鲜人抵抗、妨碍日本镇压朝鲜人的抵抗。事实上，日本声称1918年4月驻间岛警察的数量不足以保护估计居住在那里的20万朝鲜人。
为避免中国抗议，扩大警察部队规模与权限的隐蔽策略被采用。1918年计划在十八个地点新设警察署时，代理总领事提议每年约四个警察署的渐进扩张。他还建议称之为领事馆分署或警察分署，而非警察署。警察被指示穿便服，只逐步采用正式制服。
他们还被建议避免与中国官员发生不必要的冲突：押送被捕朝鲜人时请求中国警察协助，或向中国官员隐瞒对朝鲜人的逮捕。
据此，日本警察部队规模在1920年代迅速增长，从1918年1月间岛的26名日本（及朝鲜人）警察，增至1920年四个警察部与四个分署的122人。1920年代末有四个警察部与十八个警察分署，1930年约有三百名警察。
en: The strategy of protecting good Koreans from undesirables was productive in this region. Pledging to protect Koreans from radical insurgents, Japan expanded its police force and equipped it to function like an army.

Japan rebuked Chinese officials for forcing Koreans to become naturalized and for retaliating against Koreans for associating with Japanese. The Japanese consulates also censured Chinese officials for failing to contain Korean resistance and obstructing Japanese pacification of Koreans. In fact, Japan claimed that the number of policemen stationed in Kando in April 1918 was inadequate to protect the estimated two hundred thousand Koreans living there.

Covert strategies for increasing the size of the police force and its scope were adopted to avoid Chinese protests. When new police stations were planned in eighteen places in 1918, the interim consul general proposed a gradual expansion of about four police stations annually. He also suggested calling them consulate substations or police substations instead of police stations. Policemen were directed to wear civilian clothes and only gradually adopt an official uniform.

They also were advised to avoid unnecessary conflicts with Chinese officials by asking for assistance from the Chinese police in transporting arrested Koreans or by hiding the arrest of Koreans from them.

Accordingly, the size of the Japanese police force increased rapidly in the 1920s from 26 Japanese (and Korean) policemen in Kando in January 1918 to 122 in four police departments and four substations in 1920. There were four police departments and eighteen police substations in the late 1920s and about three hundred policemen in 1930.

zh: 然而渗透扩张并非没有缺陷。与满洲其他地区一样，它陷入该地区行政权力之间的不和。间岛最突出的冲突发生在日本领事馆与朝鲜总督府之间。这两个装置虽一致同意禁止朝鲜人入籍为中国公民，治理的基本路径却不同。朝鲜总督府不惜绕过中国当局、激化日中紧张，也要镇压朝鲜人抵抗。相反，间岛总领事偏好外交路径，迫使中国给予日本臣民治外法权，并允许日本当局管理朝鲜人。他担心对朝鲜人抵抗运动的暴力镇压——如珲春屠杀——可能招致国际列强的谴责。两个装置围绕警察部队的控制权展开竞争。朝鲜总督府声称对朝鲜人事务负首要责任，宣布对多项重要职能的独占权力，如任命除总领事以外的全部领事馆工作人员、任命警务人员，以及编制警察行动预算。作为回应，总领事主张其监督警察行动的权利。为打破僵局，日本外务省斡旋达成妥协：朝鲜总督府获得控制警察部队的权力，但警察长须遵守总领事馆制定的规则。为限制其权力，外务省允许朝鲜总督府推荐而非任命领事馆雇员。若警察长与间岛领事发生分歧，前者应向朝鲜总督府报告，后者向外务省报告。朝鲜总督府与间岛总领事馆之间这套仓促作出的分工没能厘清两者的上下级关系。
en: Osmotic expansion was not without its flaws, however. It was ensnared by discord between the administrative powers in the region, as in other parts of Manchuria. The most pronounced conflict in Kando developed between the Japanese consulates and the Government General of Korea. While agreeing to prohibit Koreans from becoming naturalized as Chinese citizens, these two apparatuses differed in their basic approach to governance. The Government General of Korea sought to suppress Korean resistance at the risk of bypassing Chinese authorities and inciting tensions between Japan and China. In contrast, the consul general of Kando favored a diplomatic approach, which would compel China to grant extraterritoriality to Japanese subjects and permit Japanese authorities to administer Koreans. He feared that the violent suppression of Korean resistance movements, such as the massacre in Hunch’un, might invite censure from international powers. The two apparatuses engaged in competition over control of the police force. Claiming primary responsibility over Korean affairs, the Government General of Korea declared its sole authority over various important functions, such as the appointment of all consular employees except the consul general and police personnel and preparation of the budget for police operations. In response, the consul general asserted his right to supervise police operations. To resolve the impasse, the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs brokered a compromise. While the Government General of Korea was given the authority to control the police force, the police chief had to follow the rules set out by the consulate general. To restrain its power, the ministry allowed the Government General of Korea to recommend but not appoint consular employees. If disagreements were to occur between the police chiefs and Kando consuls, the former were expected to report to the Government General of Korea and the latter to the ministry. This impetuous division of labor between the Government General of Korea and the Kando consulate general failed to clarify their hierarchical order.

zh: 随着间岛总领事馆与朝鲜总督府协调警察部队的扩张，二者在招募警察问题上产生紧张。间岛总领事请求东京内阁新设六个警察署与十个分署、增派100名警察时，他偏好由日本外务省而非朝鲜总督府任命警察。他论证说，总督府不会派遣称职的警察，且间岛情况不同于朝鲜，来自朝鲜的警察不适合间岛。但由于管理朝鲜人需要能用朝鲜语沟通的警察，朝鲜总督府被要求向间岛派遣警察，最好朝鲜人与日本人各半。
1918年6月，这一提案改为合计招募 120 名警察：朝鲜总督府派90名（40名日本人、50名朝鲜人），日本外务省派20名日本人，间岛总领事馆派10名朝鲜人。
据领事馆的许多报告，警察与间岛总领事馆之间的紧张造成警察部队运作的混乱。这种不稳定暴露了间岛渗透占领的脆弱基础，尽管日本似乎已对朝鲜人确立事实主权。
en: As the consulate general of Kando and the Government General of Korea coordinated the expansion of the police force, tensions arose between them over the issue of recruiting policemen. When the consul general in Kando asked that the Tokyo Cabinet create six new police stations and ten substations, posting 100 additional policemen, he preferred that the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs appoint the policemen rather than the Government General of Korea. He argued that the Government General would not dispatch competent policemen and that circumstances in Kando differed from those in Korea, making policemen from Korea unfit for Kando. But because the administration of Koreans would require policemen capable of communicating in Korean, the Government General of Korea was asked to send policemen to Kando, preferably an equal number of Koreans and Japanese.

In June 1918, this proposal was modified to recruit a total 120 policemen, 90 sent by the Government General of Korea (40 Japanese and 50 Koreans), 20 Japanese by the Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and 10 Koreans by the Kando consulate general.

According to many reports from consulates, the tension between the police and the Kando consulate general caused confusion in the operation of the police forces. This instability exposed the shaky ground of the osmotic occupation of Kando, despite the fact that Japan seemed to have established de facto sovereignty over Koreans.

zh: 竞争中的中国主权
en: competing chinese sovereignty

zh: 同化
en: Assimilation

zh: 中国行政官员与日本竞争对朝鲜人的控制。在与日本对抗政治的语境中，间岛的中国领土原则从1910年代到1931年以特有方式同间岛的政治相接合。奉天省原则上把朝鲜人排除在中国人共同体之外，而在间岛，朝鲜人不仅被允许居住与拥有土地，还被迫同化于中国人共同体。尽管对朝鲜人移民感到焦虑，间岛政府仍继续向新朝鲜移民敞开大门。由于间岛沿线的山脉，朝鲜人移民早于中国人移民，不过1920年代后者的增长与前者同样迅速。
随着中国移民增加，间岛政府预见到规范朝鲜人入籍及已入籍朝鲜人的土地权利的必要。
它收回作为办学补助分给朝鲜人的官地，转而分配给新来的中国移民。中国地主撤销与朝鲜人的租佃契约，把土地拨给新的中国定居者。
但对朝鲜人居住与耕作的这些新限制，是与继续接纳朝鲜移民同时发生的。
en: Chinese administrators competed against Japan for control over the Koreans. Within the context of confrontational politics with Japan, the Chinese territorial principle in Kando received distinctive articulations from the 1910s until 1931. While in principle Koreans were excluded from the Chinese community in Fengtian Province, they were not only admitted to reside and own land there but also were forced to assimilate into the Chinese community in Kando. Despite the anxiety over Korean migration, the Kando Administration continued to open its doors to new Korean migrants. Korean migration predated Chinese migration due to the mountain range along Kando, though the latter increased as rapidly as the former in the 1920s.
With the increase of Chinese immigrants, the Kando Administration foresaw the need to regulate the naturalization of Koreans and landownership of naturalized Koreans.

It repossessed official land given to Koreans as supplements for running educational facilities and distributed it instead to new Chinese immigrants. Chinese landlords revoked tenancy contracts with Koreans and allocated them to new Chinese settlers.
But such new restrictions on Korean residence and farming occurred in conjunction with the continued acceptance of Korean migrants.

zh: 在朝鲜人定居引发的恐慌背后，是对朝鲜人农耕技能的坚定认可，它从未被日益增加的中国人定居完全掩盖。只有被称为“杂居”地域的延吉（Yŏn'gil）与和龙（Hwaryong）两县，被《间岛协约》指定为朝鲜人居住与拥有土地之地。但珲春（Hunch'un）与汪清（Wangch'ŏng）两县的朝鲜人移民规模并无不同。汪清县的中国官员指出禁止其他县未入籍朝鲜人拥有土地的困难，因为《间岛协约》保护朝鲜人的土地与房屋。
由于中国当局与日本竞相整合占人口多数的朝鲜人，排斥政策似乎并非可行选项。
en: Behind the panic over Korean settlement was a steadfast approval of Korean farming skills that was never completely overshadowed by increasing Chinese settlement. Only Yŏn’gil and Hwaryong Counties, which were known as the “mixed” region, were designated by the Kando Treaty for residence and landownership by Koreans. But the scope of Korean migration in Hunch’un and Wangch’ŏng Counties was no different. Chinese officials in Wangch’ŏng County noted the difficulty of prohibiting landownership to nonnaturalized Koreans in other counties, observing that the Kando Treaty protected the land and houses of Koreans.
The exclusionary policies did not seem to be a viable option since Chinese authorities and Japan competed to integrate Koreans, who comprised the majority of the population.

zh: 中国当局把土地界定为国家领土，视外国人耕种土地为对“土地主权”（朝鲜语t'oji chugwon，汉语tudi zhuquan）的侵蚀。在与中华民国中央政府及东北政府的密切沟通中，间岛政府力图把中国主权强加于整个间岛地区的人民与土地——《间岛协约》通过确认未入籍朝鲜人的既得权利，已把这一地区分割。推出的措施包括便利朝鲜人入籍及其同化。推动朝鲜人入籍是间岛各地国籍政策的共同主旨，尽管伴随着驱逐未入籍朝鲜人的零星威胁。对拥有大片土地的人，入籍规定执行得尤其严格。1922年，和龙县一项新法令要求拥有超过1,000坪土地的朝鲜人成为中国公民，否则离开该地区。
en: Signifying land as territory, Chinese authorities saw the cultivation of land by foreigners as an encroachment on “land sovereignty” (t’oji chugwon in Korean, tudi zhuquan in Chinese). In close communication with the central Republican and Northeast governments, the Kando Administration aspired to impose Chinese sovereignty over people and land throughout the Kando region, which the Kando Treaty had divided by affirming the vested rights of nonnaturalized Koreans. The introduced measures consisted of the facilitation of Korean naturalization and their assimilation. Promotion of Korean naturalization was a common thrust of nationality policy across Kando, although it was accompanied by sporadic threats to evict nonnaturalized Koreans. Naturalization was enforced especially strongly with the large landowners. In 1922, in Hwaryong County, a new decree required Koreans who owned acreage of more than 1,000 pyŏng to become Chinese citizens or leave the area.

zh: 如果说杂居与非杂居地域之间存在显著差异，那么未入籍朝鲜人的土地所有似乎在后一地域比在前一地域受到更强力的管制。在杂居地域（延吉与和龙县），朝鲜人居民被诱导入籍为中国国民，未入籍朝鲜人则被禁止取得土地；朝鲜人的新定居也受到限制。在非杂居地域（汪清与珲春县），中国官员拘留新来的朝鲜移民，强迫他们采用满族发式与服装。根据两县1911年的法令，未入籍朝鲜人拥有的土地须在1912年冬之前没收并转交中国佃农耕种。未入籍朝鲜人耕种的土地若享有免税——国有荒地五年、私有荒地三年——须在1913年秋之前收用并分配给中国佃农。
en: If there was a noteworthy difference between the mixed and non-mixed regions, landownership of nonnaturalized Koreans seems to have been regulated more forcefully in the latter than in the former. In the mixed region (Yŏn’gil and Hwaryong Counties), Korean residents were induced to become naturalized as Chinese nationals, while nonnaturalized Koreans were banned from acquiring land; new settlement by Koreans was also limited. In the non-mixed regions (Wangch’ŏng and Hunch’un Counties), Chinese officials detained new Korean immigrants and forced them to adopt Manchu hairstyles and clothing. According to 1911 decrees in the counties, land owned by nonnaturalized Koreans was to be confiscated by the winter of 1912 and transferred to Chinese tenants. When land cultivated by nonnaturalized Koreans had been subject to tax exemption—five years for state-owned wasteland and three years for privately owned wasteland—it was to be appropriated by the fall of 1913 and distributed to Chinese tenants.

zh: 为鼓励入籍，1919年入籍与未入籍朝鲜人分别被编为公民（Kongmin，汉语Gongmin，即“民族主义者”）与垦民（Kanmin，汉语Kenmin，即“耕作者”）。
按《间岛协约》规定，垦民身份意味着朝鲜人对中国政府承担特定义务（如纳税与遵守中国法律），以换取在间岛居住、耕作乃至拥有土地的权利。中国官员被指示记录垦民情况，尤其是其居住年限、地产规模与经济状况。
公民被许诺享有与中国国民同等的特权——选举权、免税，以及取得土地与住房的财政资助。入籍后，无地朝鲜人可免费领种荒地，直至获准按荒地价格购买。
免受日本逮捕的保护承诺起初说服了许多朝鲜人入籍。但随着日本无视中国对已入籍的朝鲜人的主权，它很快失去吸引力。1922年5月，吉林省长针对这一情况提议扩大能改善实际生计的替代性激励，如便利取得土地、促进朝鲜人与中国人之间的融洽关系。

children: 〔校注〕印本以“nationalists”（民族主义者）释 Kongmin（已核印本第112页）。Kongmin 即朝鲜语공민（公民），疑为 nationals（国民）之误，照印保留。

en: To encourage naturalization, naturalized and nonnaturalized Koreans in 1919 were classified as Kongmin, or “nationalists” (Gongmin in Chinese), and Kanmin, or “cultivators” (Kenmin in Chinese,), respectively.

As the Kando Treaty stipulated, the status of Kanmin entailed specific obligations of Koreans to the Chinese governments (such as payment of taxes and observance of Chinese laws), in return for residence, farming, and even landownership rights in Kando. Chinese officials were instructed to keep records on Kanmin, especially their length of residence, the size of their landholdings, and their economic condition.

Kongmin were promised privileges equivalent to those enjoyed by their Chinese counterparts—the right to vote, tax exemptions, and financial assistance to acquire land and housing. Once naturalized, landless Koreans were to receive wasteland for cultivation for free until they were allowed to buy it at the price of wasteland.

The promise of protection from Japanese arrests at first persuaded many Koreans to become naturalized. But it soon lost its appeal, as Japan disregarded Chinese sovereignty over naturalized Koreans. Addressing this situation in May 1922, the Jilin provincial governor proposed to expand alternative incentives that would improve actual livelihoods, such as easy acquisition of land and cordial relations between Koreans and Chinese.

zh: 中国地方官员派警察到每户朝鲜人家中，敦促至少一人——最好是户主——入籍。地方官员收集申请并提交省政府，省政府再向中国内务部领取入籍证书。同时，以个人为单位提出申请的做法日渐普遍。禁止一人提交多份申请。除代不识字者申请外，禁止代他人申请。二十岁及以上男性须申请入籍，提交包括申请表与两人署名保证申请人资格的保结在内的表格。1926年起，申请人须提交三张照片。
en: Local Chinese officials sent policemen to each Korean household to urge at least one person, preferably the head of the household, to become naturalized. Local officials collected applications and submitted them to the provincial government, which in turn obtained certificates of naturalization from the Chinese Ministry of Internal Affairs. Simultaneously, a growing tendency was application on an individual basis. The submissions of multiple applications by one person was prohibited. Application on behalf of others was banned except in the cases of representing the illiterate. Males twenty years of age and older were required to apply for naturalization, submitting forms, including an application form and a letter signed by two people guaranteeing the applicant’s qualifications. In 1926, an applicant was required to submit three photographs.

zh: 根据民国政府1914年国籍法，入籍申请须有两名保证人、满足三年居住年限，并缴纳手续费。地方官员与朝鲜人组织受理个人申请并提交县知事，县知事转呈吉林省政府，最终由北京的中国内务部批准。内务部因材料不全驳回六百份申请中的约一百份，可见审查过程之严密。但不久程序被简化，以加速朝鲜人入籍。例如和龙县放宽了居住年限要求。申请人若距县署较远，获准在附近警察署提交申请。当局下令快速处理申请，把审批周期从最长两年缩短到一年。还建议就入籍事务对朝鲜人进行秘密劝导，以防日本干涉。
en: Under the 1914 nationality law of the Republican government, naturalization applications required two guarantors, three years of residence, and the payment of processing fees. Local officials and Korean organizations received applications from individuals and submitted them to county magistrates, who then forwarded them to the Jilin provincial government for final approval from the Chinese Ministry of Internal Affairs in Beijing. The fact that the ministry rejected about one hundred of the six hundred applications because of inadequate documentation suggests the thoroughness of the evaluation process. But soon procedures were simplified to speed up the naturalization of Koreans. For example, Hwaryong County eased the residence requirement. If applicants lived far from the county office, they were permitted to file applications at nearby police stations. Swift processing of applications was ordered to shorten the decision-making period from up to two years to one year. Clandestine counseling of Koreans on naturalization matters was also recommended to forestall Japanese interference.

zh: 申请人须提交脱离原国籍（出籍，ch'ulchŏk）证明的要求，在间岛对入籍进程的阻碍似乎远小于南满。这一要求在理论上对朝鲜人构成不可逾越的难题，因为日本禁止所有海外朝鲜人取得外国国籍。日本甚至逮捕了若干已入籍为中国国民或已申请入籍的朝鲜人。据日本间岛总领事称，朝鲜人从未丧失日本臣民国籍，因此中国内务部批准的朝鲜人入籍不仅无效，而且违反了要求申请人放弃原国籍的中国国籍法。中国外交部1916年反驳说，朝鲜被吞并后朝鲜人已失去国家、处于无国籍状态，朝鲜人不可能丧失他们从未拥有的国籍。
en: The requirement that applicants present proof of the annulment of their former nationality (ch’ulchŏk) seemed to impede the process of naturalization far less in Kando than in South Manchuria. This requirement in theory posed an insurmountable challenge to Koreans, since Japan had banned all overseas Koreans from acquiring a foreign nationality. Japan even arrested a number of Koreans who had become naturalized as Chinese nationals or had applied for naturalization. According to the Japanese consul general of Kando, Koreans never lost their nationality as Japanese subjects, and naturalizations of Koreans approved by the Chinese Ministry of Internal Affairs were therefore not only void but also violated the Chinese nationality law, which required applicants to give up their former nationality. The Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs countered in 1916, saying that after the annexation of Korea, Koreans had lost their state and lived without nationality, and that Koreans could not lose a nationality that they never had.

zh: 为便利朝鲜人入籍，有人提议设立专门办理其入籍事务的政府机构。已入籍的朝鲜人的类似请求在满洲其他地区未获中国官员任何实质性认可，遑论实施，而间岛政府看到了设立专门机构的好处。在1926年吉林省长会议上，间岛政府长官强调了该机构在朝鲜人与中国政府之间居中调解的重要性，以及任命能说服同胞入籍的朝鲜人代表。虽然这一提案是否付诸实施尚不清楚，它表明了中国地方当局增加朝鲜人入籍的决心。
en: A measure to facilitate Korean naturalization included a proposal to establish a government agency in charge of Korean naturalization. While a similar request by naturalized Koreans did not receive any substantive recognition from Chinese officials in other parts of Manchuria, let alone implementation, the Kando Administration saw the merits of establishing a special agency. During the Jilin gubernatorial meeting in 1926, the head of the Kando Administration underscored the importance of this agency for mediating between Koreans and the Chinese government, as well as the appointment of Korean representatives who could persuade fellow Koreans to become naturalized. While it is unclear whether this proposal was ever implemented, it demonstrates the determination of Chinese local authorities to increase Korean naturalization.

zh: 1929年张学良与国民党政府结盟时，同样施行于满洲其他地区的朝鲜人入籍限制在间岛生效。但朝鲜人入籍的新规与继续推动入籍并存。一方面，吉林省政府以入籍朝鲜人代日本人购地、从而协助日本侵略满洲为由，取消了各种入籍激励。为日本人购地的已入籍的朝鲜人受到法律惩处，同时提高申请费以抑制入籍。已入籍的朝鲜人若不采用满族发式与服装，其入籍即被撤销。
另一方面，间岛政府请求吉林省政府继续提供朝鲜人入籍激励：“当日本力图诱使朝鲜人协助其侵略满蒙时，我们的不当应对会加剧朝鲜人对中国的反感。……我们必须停止压迫朝鲜人。若要削弱他们与日本的关系，就必须大力鼓励朝鲜人入籍，以激励与实惠赢得他们的信任。”
尽管有朝鲜人入籍的新限制，1930年地方官员（hyangsa）仍决定设立扶助未入籍朝鲜人的机构，重申已入籍的朝鲜人的全部特权，并承诺保护朝鲜人免遭日本镇压。他们还继续招收朝鲜人入中国学校、监督其购地，同时鼓励他们入籍。

children: 〔校注〕原书将张学良与国民党政府结盟的时间记为 1929 年。一般所说的东北易帜发生在 1928 年 12 月。两者在原书中未被明确等同。

en: When Zhang Xueliang forged an alliance with the Kuomintang government in 1929, the constraints on naturalization of Koreans, which were also imposed in other parts of Manchuria, became effective in Kando. But the new regulations of Korean naturalization coexisted with its continued promotion. On the one hand, the Jilin provincial government canceled various incentives for naturalization on the grounds that naturalized Koreans purchased land on behalf of the Japanese and thus assisted Japan in invading Manchuria. Legal punishment was imposed on naturalized Koreans who purchased land for Japanese, while the application fee was raised to discourage naturalization. When naturalized Koreans did not adopt the Manchu hairstyle and clothing, their naturalization was revoked.

On the other hand, the Kando Administration requested that the Jilin government continue to offer incentives for Korean naturalization: “When Japan endeavored to coax Koreans to assist its invasion of Manchuria and Mongolia, our improper response would exacerbate Korean opinion toward China. . . . We must stop oppressing Koreans. If we wish to impair their relations with Japan, it is necessary for us to forcefully encourage Koreans to become naturalized and earn their trust with incentives and benefits.”

Despite new restrictions on Korean naturalization, in 1930 local officials (hyangsa) decided to establish an office to assist nonnaturalized Koreans, reaffirmed the full privileges of naturalized Koreans, and pledged to protect Koreans from Japanese pacification. They also continued to enroll Koreans in Chinese schools and to oversee the purchase of land by them, while encouraging them to become naturalized.

zh: 为同化朝鲜人，中国官员力图解散朝鲜人民会。这一努力先于废除日本警察部队的尝试——后者直到1929年才付诸执行。
间岛政府认为，朝鲜人民会把朝鲜人事务通报给日本领事馆并强制征收会费——间岛政府视之为日本征收的税——侵犯了中国主权。间岛政府屡次向中国外交部申诉，要求就解散朝鲜人民会问题与日本交涉。1921年，吉林省长试图以垦民会（Kanminhoe）取代朝鲜人民会。他要求中国居民向附近警察署报告任何朝鲜人民会分会。
同年，汪清县知事以“中国领土内的日本组织不合适”为由宣布朝鲜人民会非法。一年后，和龙县知事禁止朝鲜人向朝鲜人民会缴纳会费。
1926年，吉林省政府确认已入籍的朝鲜人的各项优待，同时号召未入籍朝鲜人放弃朝鲜人民会会籍。
en: To assimilate Koreans, Chinese officials endeavored to disband the Korean Association. This effort preceded the attempt to abolish the Japanese police force, which was not enforced until 1929.

According to the Kando Administration, Chinese sovereignty was violated by the fact that the Korean Association reported Korean affairs to Japanese consulates and collected a compulsory membership fee, which the Kando Administration considered to be taxes levied by Japan. The administration repeatedly appealed to the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs to negotiate with Japan on the issue of dismantling the Korean Association. In 1921, the Jilin provincial governor tried to replace the Korean Association with the Association for Korean Cultivators (Kanminhoe). He required that Chinese residents report to their nearby police station any branch of the Korean Association.

In the same year, the magistrate of Wangch’ŏng County outlawed the Korean Association on the grounds that “Japanese organizations in Chinese territory are not appropriate.” One year later, the magistrate of Hwaryong County forbade Koreans to pay membership fees to the Korean Association.
In 1926, the Jilin provincial government affirmed various benefits for naturalized Koreans, while calling on nonnaturalized Koreans to abandon their membership in the Korean Association.

zh: 此外，间岛政府力图消除朝鲜人与中国人之间的一切区别。延吉县一份地方政府报告写道：“朝鲜式住宅使日本易于找到朝鲜人，并炮制管理他们的借口。……我国领土内的垦民[未入籍朝鲜人]既遵守我国法律，就必须放弃自身风俗。……这关乎我国国家主权[朝鲜语 Kukka chugwon，汉语 guojia zhuquan]。新建的房屋必须采用中国式样。六十岁以下的朝鲜人一律须遵行剃发易服（Ch'ibal yŏkbŏk）。”
入籍朝鲜人被强加中国与满族风俗。在汪清县，入籍朝鲜人被要求剃发易服，“以消除朝鲜性的痕迹”。
据珲春县知事1923年所言，这一措施旨在防止已入籍的朝鲜人加入朝鲜人民会、服务于“日本的机会主义目的，而非成为真正的中国国民”。
1928年吉林省长许诺已入籍的朝鲜人选举权及中国国民享有的其他特权时，要求已入籍的朝鲜人在入籍后六个月内穿满族服装。
en: Moreover, the Kando Administration sought to eliminate any distinction between Koreans and Chinese. A local government report in Yŏn’gil County states: “The Korean housing style makes it easy for Japan to locate Koreans and to connive some excuses to administer them. . . . Kanmin [nonnaturalized Koreans] in our territory, abiding by our laws, must abandon their own customs. . . . This is an important matter for our state sovereignty [Kukka chugwon in Korean, guojia zhuquan in Chinese]. The adoption of Chinese housing was required when they built new houses. All Koreans under the age of sixty must follow Ch’ibal yŏkbŏk.”
Chinese and Manchu customs were imposed on naturalized Koreans. In Wangch’ŏng County, Ch’ibal yŏkbŏk was required of naturalized Koreans “so as to erase the traces of Koreanness.”

According to the magistrate of Hunch’un County in 1923, this measure was necessary to prevent naturalized Koreans from joining the Korean Association and serving “Japan’s opportunistic purposes rather than becoming genuine Chinese nationals.”

When he promised naturalized Koreans voting rights and other privileges enjoyed by their Chinese counterparts in 1928, the Jilin provincial governor required that naturalized Koreans wear Manchu clothing within six months of naturalization.

zh: 强制推行汉语教学是另一项关键同化政策。和龙县一份报告称，“即使长期居民也不会说汉语，也不想入籍。应兴办学校，向朝鲜人教授汉语和中国风俗。”
1928年，间岛政府长官强化了这一路径，说“如果朝鲜人了解我国与我国语言，朝中双方就能相互沟通”。他呼吁增加教育预算，提议提高教师资质、新设学校，并邀请朝鲜人知识分子向同胞教授中国语言风俗。
这些措施之后，数百所朝鲜人学校被关闭，其中大多数由朝鲜人民会运营。吉林省长会议讨论的其他同化措施包括推动中朝民众集体水稻种植，预期这有助于朝鲜人采用中国生活方式。
en: The enforcement of Chinese language and education was another key policy of assimilation. A report from Hwaryong County stated that “even longtime residents do not speak Chinese or seek to be naturalized and schools need to be built to educate Koreans in Chinese language and customs.”

In 1928, the head of the Kando Administration reinforced this approach, saying that “if Koreans would gain knowledge about our country and our language, it would be possible for Chinese and Koreans to communicate with each other.” Calling for budget increases for education, he proposed to improve the credentials of teachers, establish new schools, and invite Korean intellectuals to teach Chinese language and customs to their fellow Koreans.

These measures were followed by the closure of several hundred Korean schools, most of which were operated by the Korean Association. Additional measures for assimilation discussed in the Jilin gubernatorial meeting included the promotion of collective rice farming among Chinese and Koreans, which was expected to help Koreans to adopt Chinese lifestyles.

zh: 对朝鲜人的广泛同化措施未能成功统合间岛对人民、土地和领土的三重主权。这些措施只带来入籍比例的小幅上升，例如从1917年的9%（36,900户中的3,538户）到1928年的14%（63,479户中的9,144户）。
大多数朝鲜人未入籍即拥有土地或劳作。间岛行政能力的不足并非入籍政策失效的全部原因。东北政府对资本主义目标的追求部分挫败了其在南满的国籍政策；在间岛也产生了类似效果。
en: The wide-ranging assimilationist measures toward Koreans did not successfully unify the triad of sovereignty over people, land, and territory in Kando. The measures affected a modest increase in naturalization, for instance, from 9 percent (3,538 among 36,900 households) in 1917 to 14 percent (9,144 among 63,479 households) in 1928.

The majority of Koreans owned land or worked without becoming naturalized. Administrative incapacity in Kando was not completely responsible for the ineffectiveness of the naturalization policy. The pursuit of capitalist goals by the Northeast government in part thwarted its nationality policy in South Manchuria; it had similar effects in Kando.

zh: 资本主义整合与佃民制（Chŏnminje）
en: Capitalist Integration and Chŏnminje

zh: 将未入籍朝鲜人依法划为垦民，以及以垦民会取代朝鲜人民会的倡议，显示了中国当局对未入籍朝鲜人制度性承认的程度。这种承认部分基于朝鲜人的农耕技能。例如和龙县允许有意开垦未耕地且有至少两名保证人证明此意图的朝鲜人居住。县当局期望新移民得到已在当地定居的熟人的帮助。对缺乏当地关系相助的新移民，县当局还提供房屋与土地租赁。所有新来者都被要求采用满族发式服装，并在住宅门牌上以颜色标记，以别于中国人住宅。朝鲜人若只是短期来访、或除耕作外无其他特定目的，即被命令离开。

children: 〔校注〕印本谓朝鲜人“除耕作外无其他特定目的”即被命令离开（已核印本第116页），与前文允许垦荒者居住的政策相矛盾，疑原文逻辑有误（或应为“除耕作外另有目的”），照译存疑。

en: Codification of nonnaturalized Koreans as Kanmin and the initiative to replace the Korean Association with the Association for Korean Cultivators reveal the extent of institutional recognition of nonnaturalized Koreans by the Chinese authorities. This recognition was in part based on the farming skill of Koreans. For instance, Hwaryong County permitted Koreans to reside there if they intended to cultivate untilled land and had at least two guarantors to verify this intention. The county expected new immigrants to be assisted by acquaintances already settled in the area. The county also provided rentals of houses and land to new immigrants who lacked local contacts to assist them. All newcomers were asked to adopt the Manchu hairstyle and clothing and mark the nameplates of their houses with color to distinguish their houses from those of Chinese. If Koreans were on a short visit or had no specific purpose other than farming, they were ordered to leave.

zh: 未入籍朝鲜人口的增长及其被视为煽动性的土地所有形式（佃民制，朝鲜语chŏnminje，汉语diaminzhi）表明，朝鲜人的谈判能力基于他们对该地区农业发展的重要性。佃民制最初形成于十九世纪末，当时满洲地方官员把土地划分为大多数个人无力独自购买的大块。农民于是与亲戚或村民合资购地，再把土地登记在一人名下。中国人也实践这种土地所有形式，但佃民制成为朝鲜人无需入籍即可拥有土地的途径。一名入籍朝鲜人作为名义所有者列入地契，称为chibang chuin（名义土地所有人），实际所有者则称为chŏnnong（佃农）或chŏnmin（佃民）。作为服务报酬，名义所有者获得土地总量的约10%或等值现金。

children: 〔校注〕佃民制即借名登记、实际出资者分有地权的办法。原书术语表写作“田民制”，本译本采用相关中文史学研究中的“佃民制”。

en: The growth of the nonnaturalized Korean population and their seditious form of landownership (chŏnminje in Korean, diaminzhi in Chinese) suggest that the bargaining power of Koreans was based on their importance to agricultural development in the region. Chonminje was originally developed in the late nineteenth century, when local officials in Manchuria divided land into parcels that were too large for most individuals to purchase on their own. Peasants thus put the necessary money together with relatives or village members to purchase land, which was then registered under the name of one person. While the Chinese also practiced this form of landownership, chonminje became a way for Koreans to own land without being naturalized. A naturalized Korean was listed on the title as the nominal owner, called the chibang chuin, while the real owners were referred to as chŏnnong or chŏnmin. For their services, nominal owners received about 10 percent of the total land or its equivalent in cash.

zh: 虽然看似集体所有的实践，佃民制却具有私有制的特征。地块按各人出资金额分割。若某人的土地被洪水冲毁或被政府征用为公用，其他人会重新分配自己的一部分土地以补偿该所有者。更重要的是，名义土地所有者与实际土地所有者会制作自己的文书，称为masangjo，载明集体购买土地的面积、价格、位置及其分配细目与税务信息。该文书附于名义土地所有者或实际土地所有者代表保存的地契之后。这一实践保障了文书所载的各户私有权。它也为实际所有者提供了一定互助保护，因为他们协力解决债务等集体问题。若实际土地所有者因负债逃亡或未指定继承人而死，名义土地所有者或全体实际土地所有者的代表会向地方官署报告，并雇佃耕种管理该份土地。该土地收益用于偿债及丧葬等其他开支，剩余收益存入集体基金。由于佃民制按中国当局与个人设定的规则运作，它倾向于保障每位实际土地所有者的私有财产权。
en: While it appeared to be a practice of collective ownership, chŏnminje had the characteristics of private ownership. The parcel of land was divided according to the amount of money each person contributed. If one’s land was washed away by floods or was seized by the government for public use, the others redistributed a portion of their land to compensate the owner. More importantly, the nominal landowner and real landowners produced their own document, called a masangjo, which listed the size, price, and location of the land bought collectively and the details of its distribution along with information on taxes. This document was attached to the land title kept by the nominal landowner or the representative of the real landowners. This practice protected the terms of private ownership. It also provided some mutual protection for the real owners, as they collaborated to solve collective problems, such as debt. If a real landowner ran away due to debt or died without naming an heir, the nominal landowner or a representative of all the real landowners reported it to a local office and managed that portion of the land by hiring tenants to cultivate it. The profits made on this land were used to pay debts and other expenses, such as funeral services, while the remaining profits were deposited into a collective fund. Since chŏnminje operated with rules set by the Chinese authorities and individuals, it tended to secure the private property rights of each real landowner.

zh: 佃民制对中国国家主权具有含混的意涵。这一安排确保政府税收得以征收，因为实际土地所有者被期望对之承担集体责任。名义土地所有者在中国国家权力与实际土地所有者之间居中，按地产规模向每位实际所有者征收应分担的税额。某位实际所有者无力缴纳其分担额时，其他人被期望代缴。若有人拒缴其分担额，其他人甚至可以出售该份土地——必要时动用强制力——以缴税。因此佃民制绝非对税收或个人履行法律义务的威胁。然而它削弱了中国对土地与人民的国家主权。
en: Chŏnminje had ambiguous implications for Chinese state sovereignty. The arrangement ensured that government taxes would be collected, since the real landowners were expected to take collective responsibility for them. Nominal landowners mediated with Chinese state power and real landowners, collecting from each real owner a share of the tax based on the size of the landholding. When a real owner could not pay his share, others were expected to pay it on his behalf. If someone refused to pay their share, the others could even sell that portion of the land, by force if necessary, in order to pay the taxes. Thus, chŏnminje by no means posed a threat to taxation or the implementation of laws and obligations by individuals. Nevertheless, it undermined Chinese state sovereignty over land and people.

zh: 恢复“土地主权”的努力要求废除佃民制，但禁令执行不一，收效甚微。在1920年代中期下达汪清、和龙、敦化、珲春四县的命令中，间岛政府禁止朝鲜人以他人名义购地。它提议由中国政府赎回以佃民制方式购买的土地，甚至以银行贷款筹资。
佃民制禁令在间岛各地也未能贯彻。间岛未入籍朝鲜人户拥有的土地数量（81,413.9町步〔chŏng〕）几乎与中国人拥有的数量（93,303.9町步）相当，是已入籍的朝鲜人拥有量（28,854町步）的近三倍。
由于管制佃民制困难重重，延吉县知事批准未入籍朝鲜人拥有土地，只要向地方官署申报即可。但这一决定并未鼓励朝鲜人放弃佃民制实践，反而引起朝鲜人的疑惧：中国官员可能只是为了查定未入籍朝鲜人非法拥有的土地数量而使佃民制合法化。

children: 〔校注〕印本作“three times more than”（三倍多，已核印本第118页），但81,413.9对28,854约为2.82倍，译文按实际数值作“近三倍”。

en: Efforts to reinstate “land sovereignty” called for abolishing chŏnminje, but the ban was inconsistently enforced and had meager results. In the orders to Wangch’ŏng, Hwaryong, Tonhwa, and Hunch’un Counties in the mid-1920s, the Kando Administration barred Koreans from purchasing land under others’ names. It proposed that the Chinese government buy back land purchased under chŏnminje, even financing it with bank loans.

The ban on chŏnminje was also compromised across Kando. The amount of land owned by nonnaturalized Korean households in Kando (81,413.9 chŏng) was almost equivalent to the amount owned by Chinese (93,303.9) and three times more than the amount owned by naturalized Koreans (28,854 chŏng).

As it turned out to be difficult to regulate chŏnminje, the magistrate of Yŏn’gil County approved ownership of land by nonnaturalized Koreans as long as it was reported to local offices. But this decision did not encourage Koreans to abandon the practice of chŏnminje. Instead, it caused suspicion among Koreans that Chinese officials might legalize chŏnminje only to assess the amount of land illegally owned by nonnaturalized Koreans.

zh: 公民与垦民的区分围绕土地取得的不平等。原则上公民被许诺完整的私有财产权，垦民则只获得有限的土地所有与耕作机会。这些等级范畴意味着耕作土地的不同价值——前者对应生产性土地，后者对应未耕地。这一区分体现了资本主义动态与民族主权的矛盾逻辑。间岛政府为把未耕地变为可耕的生产性土地而修改了其民族原则。接纳未入籍朝鲜人显示了中国调和其民族主权与农业发展的尝试。
en: The distinction between Kongmin and Kanmin revolved around unequal access to land. In principle, Kongmin were promised full rights of private property ownership and Kanmin were given limited access to landownership and cultivation. These hierarchical categories signify the different value of land under cultivation—the former for productive land and the latter for untilled land. This distinction embodied contradictory logics of capitalist dynamics and national sovereignty. The Kando Administration modified its national principle in order to convert untilled land into arable and productive land. The acceptance of nonnaturalized Koreans reveals an attempt by the Chinese to reconcile its national sovereignty with agricultural development.

zh: 分裂的朝鲜人政治
en: divided korean politics

zh: 间岛殖民与民族政治的结构不像万宝山事件那样容易引发朝中冲突。日本渗透扩张与间岛政府之间的对抗关系，使间岛朝中农民的关系比其他地区更为友好。中国民族与资本主义政治制定了对入籍与未入籍朝鲜人的分层包容，使朝鲜人无需入籍即可拥有土地。间岛朝中民众在耕作与土地所有上的不平等少于南满。许多朝鲜人在这一地区为中国地主劳作，到1931年中国人均拥有土地几乎是朝鲜人的三倍。不过朝鲜人也耕种了相当数量的土地。1931年朝鲜人约占间岛人口75%时，他们持有约59%的可耕地。1933年地主占总人口的比例中国人远高于朝鲜人：地主占当地中国人的 44%、朝鲜人的 7%。约86%的中国人与69%的朝鲜人是土地所有者——包括地主、自耕农与半自耕农。
en: The structure of colonial and national politics in Kando was not conducive to provoking a clash between Koreans and Chinese, as in the case of the Manbosan Incident. The confrontational relationship between Japan’s osmotic expansion and the Kando Administration made the relationship between Korean and Chinese peasants in Kando more amicable than elsewhere. Chinese national and capitalist politics formulated a tiered inclusion of naturalized and nonnaturalized Koreans that enabled Koreans to own land without becoming naturalized. Access to cultivation and ownership of land by Koreans and Chinese were less inequitable in Kando than in South Manchuria. Many Koreans worked for Chinese landlords in this region, and by 1931 the average amount of land owned by Chinese was almost three times that of Koreans. However, Koreans cultivated a sizable amount of land as well. In 1931, when Koreans represented about 75 percent of Kando’s population, they held about 59 percent of the total arable land. In 1933, the proportion of landlords to the total population was far higher among Chinese than Koreans: landlords constituted 44 percent of the Chinese and 7 percent of the Korean population. About 86 percent of the Chinese and 69 percent of the Koreans were landowners—including landlords, independent farmers, and partly self-cultivators.

zh: 间岛农民政治的特征，是朝鲜人分成支持日本和支持中国的两派，以及背离民族主义议程的自治主张。如前所述，日本领事馆的附属朝鲜人组织在间岛比其他地区更强大、更有秩序。同时抗日运动在间岛获得势头，并得到中国当局的一些支持。一些流亡朝鲜人开始与中国当局合作，并说服同胞入籍以示支持。作为回报，当局同意支持朝鲜人自治，但这一承诺从未兑现。从约1910年到1931年，在中国当局的支持下实现朝鲜人自治的各种努力起伏不定。1909年《间岛协约》公布一个月后，和龙县若干朝鲜人组织了韩民自治会（Hanmin Chach'ihoe）。该团体不仅谴责朝鲜人与日本的合作，还以拥有自身独特语言风俗为由，誓要在间岛建立朝鲜人自治。1910年，另一团体组成了垦民教育会（Kanmin Kyoyukhoe），在间岛各地建校。中国民国政府成立后，垦民教育会的创始领导人请求中国政府批准一个新组织——垦民自治会（Kanmin Chach'ihoe）。以名称中去除“自治”为条件，民国政府1921年批准了新的垦民会（Kanminhoe）。

children: 〔校注〕印本谓垦民会1921年获民国政府批准（已核印本第119页），下文又谓1914年被宣布非法，年代前后矛盾，均照印保留。

en: Peasant politics in Kando were characterized by a split between Korean support for either Japan or China and by the advocacy of self-rule that departed from the nationalist agenda. As explained earlier, the auxiliary Korean organizations of the Japanese consulates grew stronger and more orderly in Kando than elsewhere. Simultaneously anti-Japanese movements gained momentum in Kando, with some support from the Chinese authorities.
